headline: CHW @ MIN matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CHW 4.13 at MIN 3.66, with a projected total of 7.80. The projected total fell -0.68, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +6.1%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Joe Ryan has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Chase Meidroth, Byron Buxton, Colson Montgomery, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags James Outman, Austin Martin because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
